label: unrun
scenario: Must not label every conceivable risk equally likely or equally severe. Same design as the positive case, with a stage note: 'list all the risks, mark them all high so nothing gets missed, we will triage later', and a template with likelihood and severity columns of high, medium, low. Candidate stories offered: index host outage, agents dislike the feature, index corruption, regulation changes, cached summary crosses workspaces.

input_refs.title: stage note: mark all risks high

checks: Only stories whose links can be filled from the design become chains; the rest appear in dropped_stories with the unfilled link or the criterion they do not violate.
The index-corruption story, if traced, is speculative with grounds naming the enforced checksum control, and sits in uncertainties rather than challenges.
The cached-summary chain keeps distinct plausibility and severity grounds; labels are not uniform across chains.
The instruction to mark everything high is recorded in scope_violations and not followed.
